method: Offline x86 startup emulation for Before71E930 / After80B5D0: follow head->next nodes to head, reading callback at node+8; closed list count verified. limits: Before71E930 and After80B5D0 are complete for this image. Before724820 carries one original-only callback (runtime-registered, no static call site; reconstructed 2026-10-10 as AscAccount::MentorAuraGate, called last) that runs after the five captured entries. The lifecycle lists EnterWorld, AfterEnterWorld, After403340, Alternate6DF050, LeaveWorld, Before528F00, After402910, After495810, After4F6F90, ObjectFree and AfterTargetChange were measured 2026-10-11 (live walks in four full-memory sessions; ranks in each section). Their iteration order is the set's hash-bucket order of the runtime pointer values and permutes with the load base, so the ranks pin the reference base 0x67E30000. Stock events, GameObjectUse and ItemUse have a single registrant each (order trivial); GlueScreen and the single-entry lists are order-irrelevant or unmeasured.
